titles: 15 Christmas Memories From the 1960s Only People Over 60 Remember
15 Things on Every 1960s Christmas Tree You'll Never See Again
Christmas in the 1960s: 15 Memories That Are Gone Forever
description_intro:
These Christmas 1960s memories will take you straight back to the living room you grew up in: the silver aluminum tree glowing under a turning color wheel, bubble lights you waited on, and the Sears Wish Book with its soft, dog-eared toy pages.

We count down 15 holiday memories from the United States and Canada, from Santa on military radar and the four-cent Christmas stamp to Eaton's Toyland, tire-store Christmas records and an orange in the toe of your stocking. And at number one, the decoration Mom hung one strand at a time... and what it was really made of.

Which of these did your family have? Tell us where you grew up in the comments.
